title: FloodGuard Rate Manual Rule: Pay-in-Full Discount on the Renewal Payment
content:
**Rule.** A pay-in-full discount reduces the renewal payment on a FloodGuard Private Flood Policy by 3 percent of the premium charged for the new term when the policy is on the annual plan and that premium is at least 250 USD; by 1 percent of that premium when the policy is on the annual plan and that premium is below 250 USD; and by nothing on any other billing plan.

**Records read.** The billing plan on file for the policy, and the premium charged on the premium account for the new term (the policy fee is not part of that premium).

| Billing plan on file | Premium charged for the new term | Pay-in-full discount |
|---|---|---|
| Annual | 250.00 USD or more | 3 percent of that premium |
| Annual | below 250.00 USD | 1 percent of that premium |
| Two-pay | any amount | none |
| Mortgagee escrow | any amount | none |

**The threshold, both sides.** The threshold is reached at exactly 250.00: an annual-plan premium of 250.00 takes 3 percent, while an annual-plan premium of 249.99 takes 1 percent.

**Hypothetical applications** (inputs chosen for illustration only):

- Annual plan, premium charged for the new term 250.00: the discount is 3 percent of 250.00, which is 7.50.
- Annual plan, premium charged for the new term 240.00: the discount is 1 percent of 240.00, which is 2.40.
- Mortgagee escrow plan, premium charged for the new term 900.00: no pay-in-full discount.
- Two-pay plan, premium charged for the new term 1,200.00: no pay-in-full discount.
